product_metadata.title: Grip-It YETI Tumbler Cup Handle for 30oz Rambler - Lightweight, Spill Proof Grip For RTIC Cooler Stainless Steel Tumblers, SIC, Ozark Trail & Travel Water Coffee Mugs or Flask - Electric Yellow
features: ✅ NO SLIP 30OZ TUMBLER HANDLE: The perfect tumbler handle offers maximum protection for your coffee tumbler. This handle will hold your tumbler tightly in place.

✅ ENHANCED COMFORT: The highly durable and comfortable BPA free plastic allows you to keep a firm grip on your tumbler without straining or cramping. The ergonomic design enables a relaxed grip from every angle.

✅ FITS 30 OZ TUMBLERS: This tumbler handle was designed to fit a 30 oz insulated tumbler (DOES NOT FIT RTIC 30oz Tumblers). Whether it’s from YETI, Ozark, SIC and other tumbler manufacturer, this handle accommodates most brands. Snug fit, anti-slip design.
*** NOTE*** DOES NOT FIT THE NEWER 30 oz RTIC TUMBLER (08.2017, modified shape), FITS ANY 30oz RTIC THAT HAS AN “RTIC” LOGO ON THE TUMBLER (previous shape) AND NOT THE NEW “BEAR” ANIMAL LOGO
***NOTE*** Handle Dimensions - Top Ring 12.31 inches inner circumference - Lower Ring 9.76 inches inner circumference
description: Gone are the days of spills, slips, and drops of your 30oz tumbler! Get your Rambler ready! The best outdoor Yeti cup handle for backpacking & camping gear is here! Yeti, RITC, SIC, Ozark Trail Tumblers – Fits almost any 30 oz Tumbler User Tip - Pull up on the top ring opposite of the handle to better secure the handle on the tumbler.The #1 most convenient tumbler handle that will be the saving grace of your Daily Lifestyle. Fed up with dropping and denting your 30oz tumbler? Want to unwind without having to hold your tumbler with both hands? Had enough of those clunky handles that always slip off & take up too much space?Introducing the Daily Lifestyle 30oz Tumbler Handle! BPA Free Material - The best camping tumbler handle survival gear & camping equipment that is guaranteed to be of the highest standards for you & yours Take Hold of Your Tumbler! Great for families or campers, backpackers, hikers, office workstations, car and automobile cup holders, or anytime you are ever using your rambler Ultra-light and durable, the handle is a must have camping spill proof accessory for any camping backpack Water-proof to withstand weather conditions and for easy clean up Easy grip with our wider and stronger handle than the competitions Handle fits various branded 30 oz. tumblers including, but not limited to: YETI tumbler Rambler, OZARK TRAIL (Walmart brand), BEAST tumbler, SIC Cup, Reduce (Costco brand), Grid Gear, Haute, Eskimo, Thermik, Magnum Steel, Kodiak, Boss, Polar Drifter, Gus, Engel, Titan, Polar Pad, Smart, Iconiq, Epic, Bison, K2, Zero, Kryo Kup, Iceberg, and Frosti.
